⛔ Not a claim. `priority:p2` · `domain:server` · `area:access` · `pm:awaiting-maintainer` added. Who reads deployment-level audit rows under the `single` posture is a security boundary, so the letter is the maintainer's.

Director seat, summon #51 continuation (ledger objectstack#12708). Presented to the maintainer in batch #415 as item 2 of 5. Seat increment (re-verified on `origin/main` `aa00362fe5`):
- Governing text holds: `packages/spec/src/security/capabilities.ts:81` describes `view_all_audit_log` for the walled postures and the platform administrator and says nothing about `single`; the row policy `sys_audit_log_org` is in plugin-security's default sets (`default-permission-sets.ts:214`); the read rule lives in `packages/plugins/plugin-audit/src/audit-log-read-visibility.ts` (with unit and integration tests beside it) — the file A edits. ADR-0131 D7: the ledger has no organization column; deployment-level rows carry `tenant_id` NULL.
- Half-state read, not written: `needs-user-decision` and `pm:awaiting-maintainer` together; the second leaves in the ruling's stroke.
- Facets (the card's block, re-read): ① A gives the three postures one rule (deployment-level rows are never an organization's), the data-audit / setup-audit split Salesforce and ServiceNow make; C writes a `single`-only exception into a published capability text. ② the capability is held by default only by platform administrators; a `single` deployment that built its own auditor is the one case. ③ under C a wrong grant fails silently (configuration history seen by someone nobody intended); under A it fails loudly (fewer rows, the auditor asks). ④ A is one read rule and pins, no key; C one sentence.
- The seat agrees with **A**, with the card's measurement first (`group` / `isolated` with a custom set lacking the default row policy — if NULL-tenant rows reach an organization holder there, the same PR fixes it). Not C (documents the gap) and not B (re-attributes history against ADR-0131 D7). Workload: server · 1 PR · S; changeset + upgrade note for `single` operators who granted the capability.
Prior rulings read: ADR-0131 D7, #15207, #22266, #26640 (withheld detail), #26683, #26687; thread: none.

Ruling: batch #415 item 2 · letter A · maintainer 「同意」 2026-10-28T00:34Z

Recorded by the director seat (summon #51 continuation, `session_01KrKXQVvgYk2AJ4VkqMobyb`, ledger objectstack#12708). The maintainer answered batch #415 with 「同意」 — every seat letter. Brief 6455606806. Letter **A**: in every tenancy posture, `single` included, deployment-level ledger rows (`tenant_id` NULL, ADR-0131 D7) are served only to the platform administrator (its superuser read bypass, or a separately named platform capability if the lane prefers one); an organization-scoped holder of `view_all_audit_log` reads only the rows about its organization(s). The capability description (`capabilities.ts:81`) gains the sentence that says so for `single`. Not C (documents the gap) and not B (re-attributes history).

Workload: server · 1 PR · S — first the measurement the card orders (`group` / `isolated` with a custom set that omits `sys_audit_log_org`; a NULL-tenant leak there is fixed in the same PR), then the read rule in `packages/plugins/plugin-audit/src/audit-log-read-visibility.ts` with a pin per posture, the capability sentence, a changeset and an upgrade note for `single` operators who granted the capability to a non-administrator. `Clause-②: no` (a read narrows for a custom grant; the lane declares the arm), `Metadata-protocol: none`.

Execution: `needs-user-decision` → `pm:queue` in this act (`domain:server`, p2, `area:access`); `pm:awaiting-maintainer` removed in the same stroke. The withheld detail stays on #26640. `Ruling-ref:` names this comment.
